title: Deliver Diamonds to Charhattan Springs Bank
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Diamonds** delivered to **Charhattan Springs Bank** (industry id 15, near tile 154,38).

A likely supplier is **Charhattan Springs Diamond Mine** (industry id 17, near tile 174,15); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **110 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
